title: Rights Statement Source Gate: in-copyright rows stop counting as trusted proof

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.112 UX audit exported Quality 99 and Texture 93, but patched source audit exposed two trusted sourceLedger rows whose license was the restrictive rights statement http://rightsstatements.org/vocab/InC/1.0/.
The shared source-ledger license gate treats in-copyright rights statements and all-rights-reserved claims as ambiguous license proof.
Source-finder ranking and package export inherit the stricter isLicenseAmbiguous gate before selecting trusted concept-linked source rows.
The deep quality grader flags existing InC sourceLedger rows as citation P2s, proving the captured v0.15.112 artifact was not source-clean under the intended license standard.

The release explicitly does not claim strict-clean provider output until a fresh deployed v0.15.113 ZIP/log audit proves reusable source proof replaces restricted rights-statement rows and texture reaches the strict target.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.113 ZIP/log audit must prove restricted rights-statement rows do not count as trusted sourceLedger proof.
The v0.15.112 fresh audit still measured Texture 93/100, so deterministic texture variation remains below the strict target.
Genome linkage remains 0/12 in the v0.15.112 evidence and needs source/research bridge work before strict-clean can be claimed.
